text:
APPROVE
The work is split into helpers and a `JsGateScan` class, which brings `Js` well under 15, and every step keeps its original order and logic. The old `continue` chain is now an equivalent `if`/`else if`/`else`, the shard check returns `null` in exactly the cases that used to `continue`, the bucket helper adds to the same lists, and the reports come out in the same order. I couldn't build it here, but nothing in the patch looks like it would break the build, assuming `JsInventory.Inventory` and `JsInventory.Package` are the real type names.
